topic: Key WabbleSpec Error Types and Routing
evidence: Error routing in Executor: SOFT (retry once; if retry fails -> HARD), HARD (halt wave; human-confirmed rollback), DEPENDENCY (pause; surface upstream failure; await resolution), CONTEXT_EXHAUSTION (compress context; resume from last checkpoint), SPEC_VIOLATION (pause; loop back to Specify or ScopeFrame), STALENESS_VIOLATION (quarantine evidence; surface for fresh fetch). New error types from augments: MISSING_COLD_START (Recipe Step 2d) -> await human resolution; ACCEPTANCE_NOT_COVERED (Executor post-wave) -> loop to acceptance test authorship. New from G0DM0D3: CROSS_LINK_MISSING (Document) -> loop to add cross-references section. New from InferenceGuard: inference_refusal flag in Red findings (not an error type — tracking field). COMMAND_RISK taxonomy added 2026-05-23.
